title: The best Black Friday 65-inch TV deals still available: big savings on Samsung, LG OLED, TCL, and more
excerpt: Black Friday has arrived and I've been searching through the best TV deals to find savings on 65-inch models.
content_html:
Black Friday might be officially over, but you haven't missed your chance to pick up a 65-inch TV for a bargain price. We've checked over all the deals, and there are a number of excellent price-drops still available to buy, from the likes of LG, Samsung, and TCL. We've rounded them up for you below.

A word of warning, though: although in the US most of yesterday's top deals have stuck around, it's a different picture in the UK. The UK deals are disappearing fast, so if you've been holding off buying, now's the time to take the plunge.

Scroll down for quick links to our top deals still available, and keep scrolling to see our full list of the best 65-inch TV deals to buy this weekend.
